label_provenance: Labels authored by the example's author (the building agent) when the set was written, from the rubric text alone, before any judge output was seen. They are authored calibration labels, not independent human labels; agreement with them is a count, not an accuracy rate.
separation: Every case uses a feature that is not one of the ten experiment tasks (invoices, gift wrap, receipts, coupons, loyalty tiers, bulk quotes, checkout), so calibration never doubles as an evaluated task.
